title: Scrum board, v0
description: a project's scrum board (atlas/scrum/board.json, RFC 0234): its lists in order and its cards. The single source; README.md beside it is the view people read.

board.description: The board's name; the Planner plan id its cards are claimed under.

day_hours.description: Build hours one day holds across every agent working in parallel; the plan flags a day above it. Absent means one person's day (20 h).

lists.description: The Trello lists, left to right.
